destination._comment_vat: Israel standard VAT is 18% as of 2025.
destination._comment_tiers: Israel de-minimis: <$75 exempt; $75-$500 VAT only; >$500 VAT + customs. Tiers compared on (item+shipping) value in USD.

retailers.name: Amazon.es (Spain) — PROVEN
retailers.notes: You bought the 4E here before. On Amazon.es the 4E is a 3rd-party SELLER listing (width variants like 4E come/go with stock), shipped to Israel via AmazonGlobal with prepaid Import Fees Deposit. Best route for you; set a stock alert since the seller listing fluctuates. Save the exact ASIN from your order history to monitor it directly.

retailers.name: Run and Become (UK)
retailers.notes: Has the explicit 4E Extra Wide SKU. International express shipping; confirm Israel + UK8.5/EU43 at checkout. Duties payable on arrival.

retailers.name: SportsShoes.com (UK)
retailers.notes: Ships outside EU to Israel; import duties/VAT payable on arrival. Confirm 4E width + EU43 in cart (EU stock often only up to 2E).

retailers.name: Profeet.co.uk (UK)
retailers.notes: Dedicated 4E Wide page. Confirm Israel shipping (may be UK/EU only -> forwarder); shipping_cost assumes a forwarder leg.

retailers.name: Amazon.co.uk (Global)
retailers.notes: Only Amazon marketplace likely to list 4E (UK uses the 4E label). AmazonGlobal ships to Israel (~£5.79/kg + £4.39), customs prepaid. 4E is often 3rd-party only - verify the 4E + UK8.5/EU43 variant before buying.

retailers.name: Amazon.de (Europe Global)
retailers.notes: AmazonGlobal ships to Israel with prepaid Import Fees Deposit. BUT mainland-EU Amazon does NOT carry 4E (only Medium/2E) - kept only as a long shot; use amazon_uk instead for 4E.

retailers.name: i-Run.fr (France)
retailers.notes: Large FR running store. No direct Israel shipping -> use a forwarder (Easy-Delivery FR address). shipping_cost includes the forwarder leg.

retailers.name: Keller Sports (Germany)
retailers.notes: DE running store. No direct Israel shipping -> forwarder (ColisExpat / ShipGerman). shipping_cost includes the forwarder leg.

retailers.name: Amazon US (Global)
retailers.notes: Fallback (you reported US shipping issues). Amazon Global ships many Brooks listings to Israel with an Import Fees Deposit collected at checkout.
